Market today: Tech/chip names are under pressure. Geopolitical concerns with China are spooking AI hardware stocks, and the broader chip sector is selling off, raising concerns about a deeper downturn.

Your holdings: SOXL (-49.65%) and SPAL (-56.9%) are leveraged ETFs with massive losses and non-functional stops that need immediate review. QQQ (-4.55%), QQQI (-6.79%), and SMH (-13.8%) are all on SELL/TRIM status and are trading very close to their stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the chip sector for any signs of stabilization or further weakness. Also, monitor your stops on QQQ, QQQI, and SMH.

Bottom line: Aggressive risk management, especially around your leveraged and near-stop positions, is paramount in this environment.
plays: QQQI: Respect the 52 stop. If it breaks, trim the position to protect capital.
SMH: Watch the 540 stop closely. A break could signal further weakness in chips, warranting a trim.
SOXL/SPAL: Your stops for these leveraged ETFs are above current prices. Re-evaluate and set realistic downside stops immediately.
